sentences.text: Carlos invitó a Sam a pasar un día con él.
sentences.english: Carlos invited Sam to spend a day with him.

sentences.text: Sam se despertó a las cinco y se levantó temprano.
sentences.english: Sam woke up at five and got up early.

sentences.text: Se bañó en la ducha con jabón y usó la toalla de doña Marta.
sentences.english: He bathed in the shower with soap and used doña Marta's towel.

sentences.text: Se miró la cara en el espejo, se cepilló el pelo y se vistió.
sentences.english: He looked at his face in the mirror, brushed his hair and got dressed.

sentences.text: Carlos ya lo esperaba en la calle.
sentences.english: Carlos was already waiting for him in the street.

sentences.text: —Hoy vas a ver cómo trabaja la gente del pueblo —dijo.
sentences.english: "Today you are going to see how the people of the village work," he said.

sentences.text: Primero fueron a ver al panadero, un hombre joven que se llamaba Rafael.
sentences.english: First they went to see the baker, a young man named Rafael.

sentences.text: Él se levantaba a las tres de la mañana para hacer el pan.
sentences.english: He used to get up at three in the morning to make the bread.

sentences.text: Tenía harina en la cara y en el pelo.
sentences.english: He had flour on his face and in his hair.

sentences.text: —Hago quinientos panes cada día —dijo—.
sentences.english: "I make five hundred loaves every day," he said.

sentences.text: Mi trabajo empieza cuando todos duermen.
sentences.english: "My work begins when everyone is asleep.

sentences.text: Me duele el cuello, pero me gusta.
sentences.english: My neck hurts, but I like it."

sentences.text: Doña Marta compraba pan del panadero y lo vendía en el mercado.
sentences.english: Doña Marta bought bread from the baker and sold it in the market.

sentences.text: En el mercado trabajaba un comerciante que se llamaba Mario.
sentences.english: In the market worked a merchant named Mario.

sentences.text: Vendía arroz, frijoles y plátanos.
sentences.english: He sold rice, beans and bananas.

sentences.text: El comerciante dice que ganar dinero es difícil, pero que le gusta su trabajo.
sentences.english: The merchant says that making money is hard, but that he likes his work.

sentences.text: Después llegaron al taller de Carlos.
sentences.english: Then they arrived at Carlos's workshop.

sentences.text: Era un cuarto grande, con paredes viejas y un techo alto.
sentences.english: It was a big room, with old walls and a high roof.

sentences.text: Allí había muchas herramientas.
sentences.english: There were many tools there.

sentences.text: Carlos tenía un martillo, clavos, una cuerda, un cubo y una escoba.
sentences.english: Carlos had a hammer, nails, a rope, a bucket and a broom.

sentences.text: —Las herramientas son mi vida —dijo Carlos—.
sentences.english: "Tools are my life," said Carlos.

sentences.text: Sin ellas, no tengo trabajo.
sentences.english: "Without them, I have no work."

sentences.text: Antes Carlos era empleado de una empresa de la ciudad.
sentences.english: Before, Carlos was an employee of a company in the city.

sentences.text: Su patrón le pagaba poco.
sentences.english: His boss paid him little.

sentences.text: Ahora Carlos es patrón de su taller.
sentences.english: Now Carlos is the boss of his workshop.

sentences.text: Tiene un empleado joven que se llama Diego.
sentences.english: He has a young employee named Diego.

sentences.text: —Un buen patrón escucha a sus empleados —dijo Carlos—.
sentences.english: "A good boss listens to his employees," said Carlos.

sentences.text: Diego es un buen empleado.
sentences.english: "Diego is a good employee."

sentences.text: Diego cantaba mientras trabajaba.
sentences.english: Diego sang while he worked.

sentences.text: Usó el martillo y los clavos para arreglar una mesa.
sentences.english: He used the hammer and the nails to fix a table.

sentences.text: Sam quiso ayudar.
sentences.english: Sam wanted to help.

sentences.text: Tomó el martillo, pero este cayó en su dedo.
sentences.english: He took the hammer, but it fell on his finger.

sentences.text: —¡Qué dolor! —gritó Sam.
sentences.english: "What pain!" shouted Sam.

sentences.text: Fue un accidente pequeño.
sentences.english: It was a small accident.

sentences.text: —No pasa nada —dijo Carlos—.
sentences.english: "It's nothing," said Carlos.

sentences.text: Ahora ya eres uno de nosotros.
sentences.english: "Now you're one of us."

sentences.text: Sam trabajó con la escoba y con un cubo de agua.
sentences.english: Sam worked with the broom and with a bucket of water.

sentences.text: Una cuerda se rompió, y Carlos buscó otra.
sentences.english: A rope broke, and Carlos looked for another.

sentences.text: Un clavo cuesta poco, pero sin clavos no hay mesa.
sentences.english: A nail costs little, but without nails there is no table.

sentences.text: Después, Diego usó la escoba.
sentences.english: Afterwards, Diego used the broom.

sentences.text: Por la mañana, Carlos arregló el carro de un señor que venía del aeropuerto.
sentences.english: In the morning, Carlos fixed the car of a man who was coming from the airport.

sentences.text: A las diez llegó un ingeniero en el autobús.
sentences.english: At ten an engineer arrived on the bus.

sentences.text: Venía a ver el agua del pueblo.
sentences.english: He came to look at the village's water.

sentences.text: Su vuelo tuvo un retraso, pero él llegó.
sentences.english: His flight was delayed, but he arrived.

sentences.text: Recibió un correo de su empresa y entró a un cuarto para leerlo.
sentences.english: He received an email from his company and went into a room to read it.

sentences.text: El director del colegio lo esperaba.
sentences.english: The director of the high school was waiting for him.

sentences.text: —Nuestra comunidad necesita agua limpia —dijo el director.
sentences.english: "Our community needs clean water," said the director.

sentences.text: El ingeniero miró la tierra y el agua.
sentences.english: The engineer looked at the land and the water.

sentences.text: Dijo que el trabajo es grande, pero que se puede hacer.
sentences.english: He said that the job is big, but that it can be done.

sentences.text: —Necesitamos herramientas, cuerdas y muchos hombres —dijo.
sentences.english: "We need tools, ropes and many men," he said.

sentences.text: —Mis alumnos y yo ayudamos —dijo el director.
sentences.english: "My students and I will help," said the director.

sentences.text: Él decidió quedarse tres días.
sentences.english: He decided to stay three days.

sentences.text: Él mandó un correo con el horario de la semana.
sentences.english: He sent an email with the schedule for the week.

sentences.text: Al mediodía fueron a una granja cerca del pueblo.
sentences.english: At noon they went to a farm near the village.

sentences.text: Un campesino llamado Andrés los esperaba.
sentences.english: A farmer named Andrés was waiting for them.

sentences.text: En la granja, el campesino cultivaba frijoles, tomates y cebollas.
sentences.english: On the farm, the farmer grew beans, tomatoes and onions.

sentences.text: —Hoy voy a sembrar frijoles —dijo Andrés.
sentences.english: "Today I am going to sow beans," said Andrés.

sentences.text: Tenía una bolsa con semillas.
sentences.english: He had a bag of seeds.

sentences.text: Carlos y Sam cavaron la tierra.
sentences.english: Carlos and Sam dug the earth.

sentences.text: Andrés plantó las semillas, una por una.
sentences.english: Andrés planted the seeds, one by one.

sentences.text: Sam cavó un poco más y también plantó.
sentences.english: Sam dug a little more and also planted.

sentences.text: Los campesinos cultivan lo que comemos.
sentences.english: Farmers grow what we eat.

sentences.text: Para cultivar frijoles, primero hay que cavar.
sentences.english: "To grow beans, first you have to dig," said Andrés.

sentences.text: Después se siembra, se planta cada semilla y hay que regar la tierra.
sentences.english: "Then you sow, you plant each seed and you have to water the ground."

sentences.text: Sam sembró sus primeras semillas, y regó la tierra con un cubo de agua.
sentences.english: Sam sowed his first seeds, and watered the ground with a bucket of water.

sentences.text: Andrés se cortó el dedo.
sentences.english: Andrés cut his finger.

sentences.text: Sam trató la herida con jabón, como Ana le enseñó.
sentences.english: Sam treated the wound with soap, as Ana had taught him.

sentences.text: —La piel va a sanar en una semana —dijo Sam.
sentences.english: "The skin will heal in a week," said Sam.

sentences.text: Carlos fue a la farmacia por una crema.
sentences.english: Carlos went to the pharmacy for a cream.

sentences.text: Había abejas en las flores, y también había insectos.
sentences.english: There were bees on the flowers, and there were also insects.

sentences.text: —Hay que cambiar el agua por el dengue —dijo Andrés—.
sentences.english: "We have to change the water because of dengue," said Andrés.

sentences.text: Yo no quiero enfermarme.
sentences.english: "I don't want to get sick."

sentences.text: Andrés nunca viajó a la ciudad.
sentences.english: Andrés never traveled to the city.

sentences.text: No tiene pasaporte, pero tiene tierra y desea una granja más grande.
sentences.english: He has no passport, but he has land and wants a bigger farm.

sentences.text: Andrés dice que la lluvia viene mañana y que va a regar menos.
sentences.english: Andrés says that the rain is coming tomorrow and that he is going to water less.

sentences.text: Comieron frijoles, tortillas y queso cerca de un árbol.
sentences.english: They ate beans, tortillas and cheese near a tree.

sentences.text: Sam descansó un momento.
sentences.english: Sam rested for a moment.

sentences.text: Por la tarde volvieron al mercado.
sentences.english: In the afternoon they went back to the market.

sentences.text: Un pescador de la playa vendía lo que trajo del mar.
sentences.english: A fisherman from the beach was selling what he brought from the sea.

sentences.text: —El pescador sale a las cuatro de la mañana —dijo Carlos—.
sentences.english: "The fisherman leaves at four in the morning," said Carlos.

sentences.text: Trabaja más que nosotros.
sentences.english: "He works more than we do."

sentences.text: Sam habló con él.
sentences.english: Sam talked with him.

sentences.text: Dijo que su vida es difícil, pero buena.
sentences.english: He said that his life is hard, but good.

sentences.text: Ana pasó por el mercado con una caja de vacunas para los niños.
sentences.english: Ana came through the market with a box of vaccines for the children.

sentences.text: Luis llegó del colegio después de su clase.
sentences.english: Luis arrived from the high school after his class.

sentences.text: Sam volvió a la casa muy cansado.
sentences.english: Sam went back to the house very tired.

sentences.text: Se sentó a la mesa, comió y se acostó.
sentences.english: He sat at the table, ate and went to bed.

sentences.text: Antes de dormir, mandó una foto al grupo del equipo con un correo.
sentences.english: Before sleeping, he sent a photo to the team group with an email.

sentences.text: «Hoy vi trabajar a un panadero, un comerciante, un ingeniero, un campesino y un pescador», escribió.
sentences.english: "Today I saw a baker, a merchant, an engineer, a farmer and a fisherman at work," he wrote.

sentences.text: «El miércoles vuelvo al taller.
sentences.english: "On Wednesday I am going back to the workshop.

sentences.text: Carlos cumplió lo que dijo: me enseñó todo.»
sentences.english: Carlos did what he said: he taught me everything."

sentences.text: —Trabajar es difícil, pero es bueno —pensó Sam.
sentences.english: "Working is hard, but it is good," thought Sam.

sentences.text: Doña Marta le deseó buenas noches.
sentences.english: Doña Marta wished him good night.

sentences.text: Sam quiso descansar, y durmió muy bien.
sentences.english: Sam wanted to rest, and he slept very well.
